title: RE harness fixture envelope (v1)
description: Envelope of one fixture: identity, library, the reference library's NATIVE input, and run options. It describes no diagram model: the harness defines no semantic schema or canonical form of its own (tools/re-harness/README.md, section Model). The diagram metamodel is packages/diagram-core (DiagramState); BPMN enters it through the A' codec of spec/SPEC_EVOL_GD_BPMN_MODDLE_COVERAGE.md. input is passed to the reference library verbatim: a complete BPMN 2.0 XML file with BPMNDI for bpmn-js importXML, the pinned xyflow example module itself, or a dia.Graph JSON for JointJS graph.fromJSON.

input.description: Reference-native input, never a harness model. bpmn-xml: { xmlFile } naming a .bpmn file under fixtures/, loaded verbatim by importXML. xyflow-example: { flavour, example } naming the root module of a pinned example under .ds-scrap/re-sources/xyflow/examples, compiled with its own code into an oracle bundle and mounted as the example app does. jointjs-graph-json: { cells } passed verbatim to graph.fromJSON.

idCorrespondence.description: Declared id remapping between the two compared runs (SPEC_RE_BPMN_JS_PARITY §8.3 point 2). Must be a bijection; enforced by validateFixtures and compareEvents.

renderMutation.description: Selftest only: a real rendering mutation applied through the library API before pixel capture.

pixelThreshold.description: Per-fixture pixel secondary threshold (SPEC_RE_JOINTJS_PARITY §5.3: fixed per fixture).

runnable.description: xyflow examples: whether the pinned example can run outside its application. status=unknown fixtures are never run green: the gate reports them unknown with the precise cause.
